description: This file defines a Fragment subclass 'FragmentTabsFragment' that manages a tabbed interface, with an internal static class 'TabManager' handling tab interactions and fragment management within a tab host. It sets up tabs for different fragments, restores state, and manages fragment transactions related to tab switching.

classes.name: FragmentTabsFragment
classes.description: Main fragment class managing a tabbed interface that hosts other fragments.

classes.name: FragmentTabsFragment.TabManager
classes.description: Helper class that manages tabs and associated fragment transactions within the tab host.

classes.name: FragmentTabsFragment.TabInfo
classes.description: Data structure representing each tab's metadata and associated fragment.

classes.name: FragmentTabsFragment.DummyTabFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing TabContentFactory to create dummy views for tabs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the TabManager instance when the fragment is created.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets up the TabHost, and adds tabs with associated fragments.

methods.name: onViewStateRestored
methods.description: Restores tab state after configuration changes.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up the TabManager when the view is destroyed.
